title: 02 The Doll That Moved · 自己动了的玩偶

sents.t: It's the middle of the night, and Odjac is on his phone when something downright creepy happens.
sents.zh: 深更半夜，Odjac 正在玩手机，这时发生了一件非常诡异的事。

sents.t: In the corner of his room, there's a doll.
sents.zh: 他房间的角落里放着一个玩偶。

sents.t: Odjac writes, "I was on my phone in my room when I heard something."
sents.zh: Odjac 写道：“我在房间里玩手机，突然听到了一点动静。”

sents.t: The doll appears to have moved by itself.
sents.zh: 那个玩偶似乎自己动了。

sents.t: Now, it could be that gravity was responsible for this.
sents.zh: 当然，这也可能只是重力造成的。

sents.t: But whether or not this was something paranormal, the video is still nonetheless pretty creepy.
sents.zh: 但不管这算不算灵异事件，这段视频还是挺吓人的。
